## Design note

The furniture truck that owns the right lane. Six and a half tonnes, a wall of box behind the cab and a top speed set by the fleet governor: it takes half a minute to get to motorway speed and a long way to stop. Nobody races it; everybody has to get around it, and a car that misjudges it stops dead.

## How this car breaks

Ladder frame and steel bumper take nose and tail hits; the hood and cab are ordinary sheet metal over the frame, so frontals above bumper height go into the cab. The box itself is thin aluminium on light posts — side hits dent it without hurting the truck. Side-saddle fuel tank between the axles; dual rears survive a flat.

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s medium-duty conventional box trucks (empty)

- engineering tables (commercial tire radius, leaf-spring ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 8792 | 0.85 | 7470 |
| pitch | 36809 | 0.95 | 34970 |
| yaw | 34515 | 0.97 | 33480 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.88·W·H = 6.90 m²; Cd = 0.70 → **CdA = 4.829 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.25 / +0.20 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

6.7 L OHV 24-valve turbo-diesel I6, intercooled, common-rail, medium-duty rating. Class-typical 2010s 6.7 L medium-duty diesel six (~35 kW/L, ~233 kW at 2200 rpm, ~1166 N·m at 1600) per manufacturer spec-class data; engine braking includes the exhaust brake.

Peak **233 kW @ 2225 rpm**, **1166 N·m @ 1600 rpm**. Idle 650 / redline 2600 / limiter 2800 rpm. Rotating inertia 1.00 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 15% of peak torque = 175 N·m. Power-to-weight 36 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed automatic with torque converter (vocational), open rear differential; top speed set by the limiter in 6th (fleet governor). Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Torque converter: stall 1800 rpm, 2.0× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2100 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.50 × peak torque = 1750 N·m. Shift time 0.45 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.10 | 17.27 | 23 |
| 2 | 1.81 | 10.08 | 39 |
| 3 | 1.41 | 7.85 | 50 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 5.57 | 71 |
| 5 | 0.71 | 3.95 | 100 |
| 6 | 0.61 | 3.40 | 116 |

Final drive 5.57, reverse 4.49. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.402 m.

Unloaded r = rim/2 + width·aspect; loaded r = 0.96 × unloaded (static deflection). Compound: `commercial`. Rear: dual tires, one physics wheel per side; width = 2 × section + 40 mm gap = 530 mm (aquaplaning only).

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.25 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 1429 kg | 1.60 Hz | 144400 N/m | 7180 N·s/m | 10770 N·s/m | 0.17 m |
| Rear | 1409 kg | 1.90 Hz | 200800 N/m | 8410 N·s/m | 12620 N·s/m | 0.19 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 4.5°/g with 65% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.949 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 770125 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 297565 F / 336211 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **49300 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 4.1°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 1200000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 380 mm disc, pistons per side 66 mm + 66 mm → A = 68.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 165 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·68.4 cm²·0.165 m = **9032 N·m**
- Rear: 380 mm disc, pistons per side 66 mm + 66 mm → A = 68.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 165 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·68.4 cm²·0.165 m = **9032 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 9099 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.99×), rear needs 3721 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.43×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 3693 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.710** → delivered 9030 N·m front / 3688 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 3610 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 20.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 16.5 m → outer-front path radius 8.13 m, rear-axle-centre radius 5.71 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.675 rad (38.7°)** (outer 34.2°, inner 44.3° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 0.9 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/gantry_box.json`)

351 nodes, 2152 beams, 6 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id gantry_box --profile truck --width 2.45 --length 7.6 --height 3.2 --wheelbase 4.57 --mass 1429.0 --car-mass 6495.7 --clearance 0.3 --front-overhang 1.05 --strength 1.15` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 4).
- Era `2010s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Steel hood: 186 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 18 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 16 under-cab rail beams → hss 9.08e-04 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Side-saddle fuel tank outboard of the left frame rail between cab and rear axle.
